diagnostic_findings: CASPER_ADAPT_NO_HEALTH, CASPER_HEALTH_STATIC, and CASPER_FULL are exactly outcome-equivalent to RANKED_CP_STATIC across all frozen E4.2 seeds/scenarios for the reported FWC/AIR/FAR/DVR/P99 metrics.
For both adaptive policies, reported late_eta is exactly 1.0 in every frozen E4.2 run, so the E1.7 layer did not alter the late-window conformal multiplier.
Compute alarm coverage is far below the prelocked 0.90 target in S2 and S4 and, across these 30 seeds, higher final alarm coverage is not associated with improved late FWC.

Run-level aggregate evidence cannot determine whether the event-level cause is alarm latency, probe targeting, candidate-set composition, sticky exclusion timing, or adaptation-detector non-triggering.
